<!--
Read CODE.md before opening a PR. Solve one underlying problem.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language,
such as "fix(cli): task listing no longer drops closed tasks".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem or need in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior
and reproduction steps or environment where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this addresses the problem and what the developer can now do.
Include the command or entry point needed to try it. If it spans components,
explain why those changes are needed for the same outcome. -->

## Scope

<!-- State what is included and what remains incomplete or outside this change.
Link the relevant Beads task or issue when one exists. Split independent changes. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran and the observed results
for the changed behavior. State anything you could not check.
"Tests pass" alone is insufficient.

For UI changes, include clear before/after screenshots. Include a short recording
when motion, timing, transitions, or interaction details demonstrate the change.
For CLI changes, include the command and actual output.
For performance improvements, include before/after measurements, the workload,
and the measurement method.

Upload evidence to GitHub and embed or link it here. Never commit PR-only assets.
-->
